entries.7396ec5a9ecc0830: Looking ahead to 2050, the company has formulated a long-term management strategy and a three-year medium-term management plan, “Polishing True Value 2028” (fiscal 2026 to fiscal 2028), aiming to realize its management vision, “Beautiful Keihan Lines, toward a Keihan Group Connected to the World.” The company has set out the aim of continuing to raise the value of the Keihan lines as “a town-building company that enriches life and tourism”; its core long-term management strategies are “Re-cultivating the Lines,” “Co-creating Experience Value” and “Global Environmental Conservation,” and it says it will promote management centered on “BIOSTYLE,” which it positions as the Keihan version of the SDGs.
